mapper.sql: sbp.id, sbp.create_user_id, sbp.create_user_name, sbp.create_time, sbp.update_user_id, sbp.update_user_name, sbp.update_time, sbp.version, sbp.is_deleted, sbp.so_id as soId, sbp.so_code as soCode, sbp.so_approve_status as soApproveStatus, sbp.so_qty as soQty, sbp.delivery_notice_id as deliveryNoticeId, sbp.delivery_notice_code as deliveryNoticeCode, sbp.delivery_notice_approve_status as deliveryNoticeApproveStatus, sbp.delivery_qty as deliveryQty, sbp.sku_id as skuId, sbp.warehouse_id as warehouseId, sbp.virtual_warehouse_id as virtualWarehouseId, sbp.frozen_time as frozenTime, sbp.frozen_qty as frozenQty, sbp.outstock_order_id as outstockOrderId, sbp.outstock_order_code as outstockOrderCode, sbp.outstock_order_type as outstockOrderType, sbp.outstock_order_status as outstockOrderStatus, sbp.outstock_order_time as outstockOrderTime, sbp.outstock_qty as outstockQty, sbp.parent_sku_id as parentSkuId, sbp.bom_version as bomVersion, pd.sku_no as skuNo, pd.name as productName, wh.name as warehouseName, vw.name as virtualWarehouseName
mapper.select:
select
from so_b2b_processing sbp left join product_detail pd on sbp.sku_id = pd.id and pd.is_deleted = false left join warehouse wh on sbp.warehouse_id = wh.id and wh.is_deleted = false left join virtual_warehouse vw on sbp.virtual_warehouse_id = vw.id and vw.is_deleted = false where ${params.sqlMap.default} and sbp.is_deleted = false
and sbp.outstock_order_id = ''
and sbp.delivery_qty != sbp.frozen_qty and sbp.delivery_notice_id != ''
and sbp.outstock_order_id = ''
and sbp.outstock_order_id = '' and sbp.frozen_time != null and EXTRACT(DAY FROM (now() - sbp.frozen_time)) >= 7
ORDER BY
${item.field} ${item.sort}
sbp.id DESC

select si.id as soId, si.code as soCode, si.approve_status as soApproveStatus, sd.qty as soQty, sdn.id as deliveryNoticeId, sdn.code as deliveryNoticeCode, sdn.approve_status as deliveryNoticeApproveStatus, sdnd.id as deliveryNoticeDetailId, sdnd.delivery_qty as deliveryQty, sd.sku_id as skuId, si.warehouse_id as warehouseId, si.virtual_warehouse_id as virtualWarehouseId, COALESCE(sd.frozen_time,sdn.create_time) as frozenTime, sd.frozen_qty + COALESCE(sdnd.delivery_qty,0) as frozenQty from so_info si inner join so_detail sd on si.id = sd.main_id and sd.is_deleted = false left join so_delivery_notice_detail sdnd on sd.id = sdnd.source_detail_id and sdnd.is_deleted = false left join so_delivery_notice sdn on sdn.id = sdnd.main_id and sdn.is_deleted = false and sdn.invalid_status = false where si.is_deleted = false and si.invalid_status = false and si.virtual_warehouse_id != ''
and si.create_time > #{startDate}
